fields.customfield_10618:
Will change the definition from:

"The specific element to use in the referenced profile. This is used when a backbone element is being profiled, rather than an established type."

to

"Provides the snapshot.element.id of the element within the profile containing this extension to use as the starting point for validation of the element on which the profile is declared. This is used when a backbone element is being profiled, rather than an established type."
fields.description:
The definition of the element doesn't actually say how it works, and it needs to. 

 

Note, the definition is based on the current functionality of the validator: that the inner element is identified by it's ElementDefinition.id which is controlled per the specification 

See [https://github.com/HL7/fhir-extensions/pull/138]

resolution.description: The proposed change will be made as suggested
resolution.name: Persuasive

status.description: An official version containing the requested change has been released
status.name: Published
